Chapter 7176: Bulwark Of Apocalypse

Chapter 7176: Bulwark of Apocalypse

“The first line of defense, always.” Those who didn’t abandon their world and people were moved to tears.

Desolate Frontier was the most barren of the nine major worlds. However, it was the heaviest and the closest to the high heaven.

Despite the unfavorable circumstances, the immortals here willingly faced the first wave of the tribulations. This time, the wall might not hold since the true body was coming.

“Boom!” The tribulations struck the wall, causing cracks to appear.

“Ahh!” A few immortals couldn’t handle the damage, pierced by lightning bolts.

“Seal!” An ultimate empress emerged to support the wall, wielding the momentum of Desolate Frontier.

Alas, she vomited blood from the impact.

“Empress Hongtian!” Spectators shouted.

Although she fully displayed her might, a single tree couldn’t build a pavilion.

“Go!” Another cultivator in the form of the grand dao helped fortify the connection between all the defenders on the wall.

“Origin Heaven Emperor!” Some recognized this cultivator.

“Buzz.” A massive dao platform made of the most precious stones and materials became radiant in Desolate Frontier.

In fact, several celestial immortals working together couldn’t have gathered this many resources. It turned out that Duality and Origination Enterprise have offered everything they had for building this dao platform.

“Boom!” The dao platform refined the materials into the purest energy sources. They coursed through the wall and the defenders under Origin Heaven Emperor’s direction, ending with Empress Hongtian.

The cracks finally disappeared to spectators’ astonishment.

“Rumble!” However, this was only the beginning. Incredible tsunami of lightning bolts appeared next, ready to drown the wall.

The defenders turned pale, barely able to stop the first wave.

“Splash!” A mightier wave came next and everyone thought it was over.

“Grand Thousand World!” A primordial tree appeared, towering over a major world.

It grew at an insane rate, reaching Desolate Frontier in the blink of an eye and sending more energy into the platform.

Roots and stems grew and embedded themselves into the wall.

In Grand Thousand World, Hao Cai, Immortal Emperor Xue Xi, Immortal Monarch Yi Ye, and many more immortals empowered their world’s grand momentum.

All living beings of this world willingly joined the defense, offering their faith and dao power. The primordial tree surpassed the limits of time and space, connecting two major worlds.

“Boom!” They survived the second wave but there was no end in sight.

Remnant blast waves made it through the wall and destroyed several minor worlds.

As more waves struck, cracks appeared on the wall once more.

Spectators couldn’t imagine the horror of this first round of tribulations. The immortals on the wall were hanging on for dear life, attempting to heal their ravaged body.

“Golden!” Golden World joined the fray, sending out countless golden laws resembling dragons.
